text:
Tara: quick post-launch note  we've got two paths: prioritize the runtime bug that raised tail latency for long sessions, or ship the 10 small UX asks that pilot customers expect before wider rollout. thoughts?

Ben: need impact data. if SLAs or pilot expansions at risk -> bugs-first.

Tara: impact: 3 pilot customers reported degraded tail latency (p99 from ~600ms -> ~1.1s) on 10k+ token sessions during load windows. No increased error rates, but retries and customer concern.

Omar: +1 bugs-first. runtime debugging needs deep focus. polish can be batched into a follow-on minor and communicated as "coming next week."

Keisha: product risk: one strategic pilot explicitly asked for a copy + onboarding tweak before they expand. delaying might slow their ramp. can we do a small async polish squad?

Ben: tradeoff: we can do bugs-first with a small asynchronous polish lane (1 designer + 1 dev part-time). runtime freeze for serving changes except hotfixes for the week.

Tara: proposal: 6-day micro-cycle. Day 0: triage & owner assignment. Day 1-3: perf squad (Omar lead) full-time. Day 2-5: polish owners (Keisha lead) part-time, only low-effort items. Day 5: canary + roll if green. Freeze serving merges to main except hotfixes.

Omar: estimate: profiling + two targeted runtime experiments ~4 engineer-days, canary + validation 1 day. need ops canary pool for 6h.

notify-bot: Canary reservation requested: canary-pool-19, 3 GPUs, 6h. Reservation ID: rsv-9191.

Keisha: polish estimate: 10 items, 6 are low-effort (copy, small modal change, label fixes). I can get 3 done in 2 days with quick reviews. will tag them with label:postlaunch-polish.

Ben: acceptance criteria: perf: p99 <=700ms for 10k token sessions under staging harness or retries <=0.4% sustained for 4h. polish: close >=60% of low-effort items and publish updated onboarding snippet.

Tara: canary steps (pinned):
```
1. deploy runtime-experiment-a to canary-pool-19
2. route 5% traffic for 2h
3. run perf harness: ./perf/long_sessions --tokens 10000 --qps 40 --duration 120
4. collect p95/p99, kvcache pressure, retry rate
5. if metrics stable for 90m -> increase to 25% for 3h
```

Omar: will post the experiment diffs in #eng-runtime and open the hotfix PR. tagging label:hotfix and referencing this thread_ts.

Keisha: I'll publish the polish checklist in the sprint card and add quick PR templates to speed review. only merge polish PRs if they don't touch serving/runtime.

Ben: decision: spin up perf-squad (Omar lead + 2 engs), async-polish lane (Keisha lead, 1 dev, 1 designer), freeze serving merges except hotfixes, ops to run the canary rsv-9191. I'll update roadmap timeline and tell sales to set expectations for pilots.

Tara: good. comms: tell the strategic pilot we're deploying a targeted perf mitigation this week, and that low-effort UX items are scheduled for a follow-up patch by next week. draft blurb: "We're rolling a targeted mitigation for long-session tail latency this week; UX improvements will follow as a small patch next week."

Omar: starting triage now. will post findings and profiling logs in this thread.

Keisha: starting the low-effort list now; will ping for quick reviews. check-in tomorrow 11:00am. :thumbsup:
